captions.detailed: This 3D model presents a customizable, two-part circular cuff bracelet with integrated hinge mechanisms on both ends. One side features a prominent, thick cylindrical attachment bracket on its outer wall, containing a large vertical hole designed to pass a rope or string through. Inside the ring are two separate, thin locking pins with square heads that are used to secure the hinges together once printed.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, two-piece cuff bracelet with interlocking hinge segments on both ends. The design must include variables to control the inside diameter, cuff width, wall thickness, and an optional cylindrical attachment bracket with a hole for a rope or lanyard, along with separate printable locking pins.
captions.factory: The script defines the cuff pieces using boolean subtraction (difference) on concentric cylinders to establish the inner and outer diameters. The hinge knuckles are formed using smaller cylinders with holes aligned vertically. An optional attachment point module uses a rounded cube joined to a cylinder with a central hole, while separate pin and key modules are built using cylinders with square-headed bases (rounded_cube helpers) for easy manual removal.
